content:
opsbot: INCIDENT P1 detected: auth failures for login and console access. A large spike of 401s against /oauth2/v1/introspect and JWT verification errors across regions. paging @oncall now. https://alerts.example.com/alert/9876
meera: seeing it in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Console 403/401 for staff; some customer logins failing.
devon: Confirmed. Error in logs: "kid not found in JWKS" from our token verifier. Sample: `jwt: failed to verify signature: kid abc123 not present`
sam: correlation: Okta updated a cert yesterday at ~11:40 UTC per last webhook. Maybe rotation incomplete?
meera: Okta status shows no global outage but we have 5xxs on their jwks endpoint from eu cluster. https://status.okta.com/notes
jonathan: Paging Okta support and opening ticket. @okta-support-bot ticket created: INC-23456 — AGENT ASSIGNED.
sre-lead: Quick mitigation plan: 1) enable cached JWKS fallback for 15m 2) relax strict kid mismatch for legacy tokens in verifier (feature flag) 3) route auth checks to standby region if jwks endpoint fails. Who can flip the flag?
meera: I can flip the flag. Doing `POST /admin/flags/allow_legacy_jwks true` now.
meera: flag set. Rolling restarts of auth-check service will pick it up.
devon: Deploy triggered: `kubectl -n authroll deploy auth-checkers --image=auth-checker:v2.4.1` (rolling)
opsbot: Deploy started by devon at 1799999010.
meera: Logs now show fallback to cached JWKS, token verification rate of failures dropped ~68% in eu-west-1. Still seeing ~12% failing in us-east-1.
jonathan: Okta agent: they confirm a partial JWKS propagation delay in eu1 due to CDN invalidation. Okta estimates 20m for propagation.
sam: Customer impact estimate: 7% of console sessions in EU, 3% global logins. A handful of enterprise customers behind strict SSO policies blocked.
sre-lead: Notify CS and post to status page. @status-bot, publish interim: "Investigating increased auth failures; workaround in progress (cached JWKS). Some customers may be unable to login."
status-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai at 1799999105.
meera: Sending customer comms draft to CS: "We’re seeing intermittent login failures due to third-party identity provider certificate rotation. We’ve applied a temporary fallback. We’ll follow up when Okta confirms full propagation."
devon: Additional observation: Datadog traces for auth-checker are missing identity headers for failed requests — likely upstream header change. I've added a quick fallback to log raw request for 1% sampling.
jonathan: Okta support on call says they pushed a hotfix; waiting for CDN purge to complete. ETA 12 minutes.
sam: Can we mitigate enterprise SSO policies? Some customers enforce strict audience checks that reject fallback tokens. We should reach out to affected accounts directly.
meera: Listing affected customers from auth logs now. Uploading CSV to secure_conversations.
meera: Handoff to next on-call in 30m. Summary for handoff: actions taken - feature flag enabled to allow legacy JWKS, rolling restart of auth-checker, status page update, ticket opened with Okta (INC-23456). Remaining: monitor for full propagation, revert flag after Okta confirms, follow up with affected customers.
sre-lead: Good. jonathan stay on the Okta thread until resolved, meera proceed to customer outreach. devon, keep watch on rollout and perf.
jonathan: Okta support: propagation completed at 1799999200, JWKS endpoint healthy, they recommend leaving caches for 10m and then clearing.
meera: Clearing cached JWKS now: `POST /admin/cache/clear jwks`
devon: Clearing done. Starting controlled rollback: `POST /admin/flags/allow_legacy_jwks false` — will wait 5m for observation before full turn-off.
opsbot: Flag toggle performed by devon at 1799999215.
meera: Verification: auth verification errors down to baseline. Console access restored for previously impacted sessions.
sam: Customer impact final: ~700 affected sessions, ~120 paying customers saw at least one failed login attempt, no data loss, no tokens compromised.
sre-lead: Closing notes: root cause — partial JWKS propagation at IdP during cert rotation causing kid mismatch. Mitigation — temporary acceptance of cached/legacy JWKS and routing, close coordination with Okta. Follow-ups: add circuit-breaker for JWKS 5xxs, add per-region JWKS caching with TTL, and improve customer-targeted alerts.
meera: I'll create follow-up tickets and a post-incident blameless writeup.
jonathan: Okta agent posted final note and closed their incident on their side.
opsbot: INCIDENT P1 resolved at 1799999222.
meera: Handoff to next on-call: all items logged in INC-1799998888-summary, please review.#handoff
__notes: auto-generated slack-thread mock for incident training
